gitCommit.subject: Deletion and privacy pages: what is removed, and what cannot be
gitCommit.body:
Deletion and privacy pages: what is removed, and what cannot be

The deletion page lists what a deleted login and a closed business lose,
and says that the sealed audit trail, subscription history and backups
are not edited. The de-identification gaps blocker is replaced by two
open decisions: legal approval of the sealed-history disclosure, and the
backup retention period TSX-MR has not yet supplied.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
